Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check voltage at charger (~230V) and upstream (Isolator, EVDB, Meter).
Action Required: Technician: Rectify faulty component; Tighten loose termination

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Turn off power immediately. Check inside for melted or discolored parts.
Action Required: Technician: Replace damaged components; Rewire if necessary

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Test power input and check CP signal output.
Action Required: Technician: Repair internal circuit or Replace mainboard

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check the isolator switch on the side of the unit.
Action Required: User/Technician: Flip switch to ON; Replace isolator if faulty

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check for short circuit/overload. Try resetting the MCB.
Action Required: Technician: Fix overload issue; Replace MCB if it trips repeatedly

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check main supply connection for loose wires, voltage drops, or overheating.
Stop charging for 15 mins if overheating. Check TNB main fuse.
Action Required: User: Contact TNB to replace fuse

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check app for 'Grounding Issue' under 'Fault'. Ensure firmware is V44.
Action Required: User/Technician: Update firmware via App; Check grounding connection

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check for Over Current. Measure voltage while charging.
Action Required: Technician: Check cabling and TNB supply stability

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Restart charger a few times to fix hardware or MCB issues.
Action Required: Technician: If issue persists, proceed with replacement process +1

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Keep phone within 1m. 'Forget This Device' in Bluetooth settings and reconnect.
Action Required: User: Grant location permissions; Try with another phone

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check MCB rating (40A for 7kW, 63A for 22kW) and phase pairing.
Action Required: Technician: Replace with correct MCB rating; Ensure phase alignment.
Technician: Ensure supply voltage is within standard range

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check Grounding resistance (<40Ω) and N-PE voltage (<4V).
Action Required: Technician: Take photo of readings; Improve earthing if failed

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check terminal voltage. Verify Connection Mode in e.BOX App.
Action Required: User: Correct Connection Mode setting; Save and restart +1

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Ensure 'Charge Scheduled' is disabled in e.BOX app or vehicle.
Action Required: User: Turn off scheduled charging at both App and Vehicle

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Turn OFF 'Auto' Load Balance in e.BOX app.
Action Required: User: Manual configuration of load balance settings

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Get detailed logs from 'Error Report' in e.BOX App settings.
Action Required: User: Submit screen recording and Error Report to PRO-NET
